_comment: Run the 16-token sealed gate against the trace-guided DEE4 v3 store with bounded parallel host fills and full stage profiling.
_comment_phase4: Phase-4 arm-matrix knobs (applied only when the matching NATIVE_* env var is absent; env always wins). arm_id is metadata only -- run_id stays constant across arms so route journals hash-compare. trace_requests requires profile_stages (auto-enabled loudly if NATIVE_PROFILE is unset). host_cache_mode=bypass clamps the host pack to one record + lanes=1. cache_reset: warm|cold.
